fact: The government launched the EU-funded, Expertise France-implemented e-Administration project, whose stated scope includes interoperability between ministries and institutions for secure data sharing; no platform is described as built or in service.

The AfDB board approved EUR 9.51 million for the Project to Support Digitization of the Comorian Economy, which funds an interoperability and data-exchange platform among other components; no build or service status is given.
